info.name: Creates or updates a pmem device. Pre-boot only.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the guest pmem device

items.docs: Creates new pmem device with ID specified by id parameter. If a pmem device with the specified ID already exists, updates its state based on new input. Will fail if update is not possible.

info.name: Updates the rate limiter of a pmem device. Post-boot only.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the guest pmem device

items.docs: Updates the rate limiter applied to the pmem device with the ID specified by the id path parameter.
